docstring: If $G$ is an edge-disjoint union of $n$ copies of $K_n$, then is $\chi(G) = n$?
references: [Hi81] Hindman, N., *On a conjecture of Erdős, Faber, and Lovász about $n$-colorings*. Canad. J. Math. (1981).
[Ka92] Kahn, J., *Coloring nearly-disjoint hypergraphs with $n + o(n)$ colors*. J. Combin. Theory Ser. A (1992).
[KKKMO21] Kang, D. Y., Kelly, T., Kühn, D., Methuku, A. and Osthus, D., *A proof of the Erdős–Faber–Lovász conjecture*. Ann. of Math. (2023). [arXiv:2101.04698](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.04698)
type_pretty: ∀ (V : Type) (n : ℕ) (C : Erdos19.EFLConfig V n), C.graph.chromaticNumber = ↑n
